integrity: The proof is an explicit cohomological calculation; no computational certificate is required.
Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is a single projective simple-normal-crossing example and concerns only first-order deformations of the projective scheme itself.
It does not settle deformation questions for the affine cone or higher-order/formal rigidity.
title: A projective normal-crossing surface with local but no global first-order deformations
